Jacobs was originally awarded the program and construction management contract in August 2023. Jacobs will continue to coordinate design, logistics, and construction.
Once complete, the plant is expected to produce approximately 2.5 million metric tons of direct reduced iron a year, replacing coal-powered blast furnaces with a hydrogen-based process.
